description: Side-by-side open-data figures for 2 to 6 London postcode districts and London as a whole: median sold price of existing houses, residential crime per 1,000 residents, Outstanding state schools, share of postcodes in flood zone 3, Band D council tax, the main borough's ONS official rent, the share of residents in England's most deprived 20% of areas, Census 2021 tenure, and optionally commute minutes to one hub.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms for the official rent column: all (default), 1, 2, 3 or 4+.

districts.description: 2 to 6 outward codes or postcodes, e.g. ["E17", "E10", "N17"].

items.description: A London postcode district (outward code) such as "E17" or "SW11", or a full postcode such as "E17 4QH".

hub.description: Add typical commute minutes to this work hub.

name: compare_london_districts
title: Compare London postcode districts
